# Outfox Markets

> Outfox maps the public companies that build the AI economy, compares how its
> supply-chain layers perform, and connects those companies with official U.S.
> House stock-disclosure records.

Site: https://outfoxmarkets.com
Tagline: Financial intelligence for the rest of us.

## What Outfox helps readers understand

Outfox organizes companies by their position in the AI value chain rather than
only by traditional market sectors. The current map covers ten editorial layers:

1. Software & Models
2. Cybersecurity
3. Data Centers
4. Energy Infrastructure
5. Networking
6. Processors
7. Memory & Storage
8. Foundries
9. Semiconductor Equipment
10. Raw Materials

Layer membership is an Outfox editorial classification, not an industry
standard, investment rating, or recommendation.

## Sources and calculations

- House disclosures come from periodic transaction reports published by the
  Clerk of the U.S. House of Representatives. Displayed records retain an
  official government filing link.
- Current quote cards use Finnhub and may be delayed.
- Historical comparisons currently use an unofficial Yahoo Finance chart
  integration and may contain delayed or adjusted closing values.
- Performance charts show percentage change from the first available closing
  value in the selected period. Layer lines are equal-weight averages of
  available constituents.
- Full methodology: https://outfoxmarkets.com/methodology
- Corrections policy: https://outfoxmarkets.com/corrections

## Important limitations

- Public-official coverage is currently U.S. House only. Senate disclosures are
  not yet included.
- Periodic transaction reports may be filed weeks after a transaction and may
  later be amended or corrected.
- Disclosed transaction amounts are ranges rather than exact values.
- A disclosure is a public record of a reported transaction. It does not prove
  motive, performance, insider knowledge, or wrongdoing.
- Outfox is an educational information service, not a broker, registered
  investment adviser, or fiduciary. Its content is not personalized advice.

- https://outfoxmarkets.com/ — interactive AI-economy map and comparisons

- https://outfoxmarkets.com/about — Outfox's purpose and limitations

## Citation guidance

Cite the applicable Outfox page and its displayed source date. When referring
to public-official transactions, state that coverage is House-only and that
filings are delayed public disclosures rather than real-time trade signals.
